description: This file contains task management services for a project management backend, including functions for listing, creating, updating, deleting, and changing the status of tasks, as well as assigning tasks to users. It handles user access verification, activity recording, and websocket notifications.

methods.name: Project _ensure_project_member(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Verifies that a user is a member or owner of a specified project and returns the project.

methods.name: List[Task] list_tasks(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Lists all non-archived tasks for a project if the user has access.

methods.name: Task create_task( db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, user_id: int, title: str, description: Optional[str], status_value: str, priority_value: str, due_date=None, assignee_id: Optional[int] = None, )
methods.description: Creates a new task within a project, assigning it to a user if specified, validating project membership, and broadcasting updates.

methods.name: Task update_task(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, task_id: int, user_id: int, updates: dict)
methods.description: Updates specified fields of a task if the user has access and broadcasts the change.

methods.name: Task change_status(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, task_id: int, user_id: int, status_value: str)
methods.description: Changes the status of a task and records the activity.

methods.name: Task assign_task(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, task_id: int, user_id: int, assignee_id: int | None)
methods.description: Assigns or unassigns a task to/from a user and records the activity.

methods.name: None delete_task(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, task_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes (archives) a task if the user has access, and broadcasts the deletion.
